files.rationale: Gherkin validation artifact covering the reviewed IdeaMade note creation, autosave persistence, switching, and deletion workflow.
files.patch:
--- /dev/null
+++ automation/features/ideamade-workflow.feature
@@ -0,0 +1,18 @@
+Feature: IdeaMade note workflow
+  Users can write, revisit, and remove idea notes in a focused notepad-style app.
+
+  Scenario: Complete idea note workflow persists locally
+    Given the user opens the IdeaMade app
+    Then the idea empty state is visible
+    When the user creates a new idea note
+    And the user fills in the idea title with value "Weekend market pop-up"
+    And the user fills in the idea body with value "A compact booth concept for handmade notebooks, prompt cards, and quick sketch consultations."
+    Then the idea list should contain the text "Weekend market pop-up"
+    When the user reloads the page
+    Then the idea note "Weekend market pop-up" is restored with the body text "A compact booth concept for handmade notebooks, prompt cards, and quick sketch consultations."
+    When the user creates a new idea note
+    And the user fills in the idea title with value "Pocket pitch recorder"
+    And the user selects the idea note "Weekend market pop-up"
+    Then the idea note "Weekend market pop-up" is active
+    When the user deletes the idea note "Weekend market pop-up"
+    Then the idea list should not contain the text "Weekend market pop-up"

files.rationale: Playwright/Cucumber step definitions that make the IdeaMade reviewed validation scenario executable against the target app.

customStepJustifications.missingCapability: IdeaMade-specific note workflow steps for restore-by-title/body verification, note selection by title, active note assertion, and confirmed delete flow.
customStepJustifications.whyLocatorsAndExistingStepsAreInsufficie: The registry has generic click/fill/assert/reload primitives and a prior notepad workflow shape, but no reusable step path for this target workspace's IdeaMade note model or its required test ids. The custom file binds those reviewed locators to executable Playwright/Cucumber behavior for this app.
